crossRefs.note: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel traveled; and in the place…
When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm…
They first went forward according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.
It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.
Yahweh said to me, “Arise, take your journey before the people; and they shall go in and possess the land which I swore…

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of Yahweh. These are their journeys according to their starting points.
translations.bsb: At the LORD’s command, Moses recorded the stages of their journey. These are the stages listed by their starting points:
translations.kjv: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.
translations.asv: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of Jehovah: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.
